about: The fewest passing titles scripts/loam-exit-check.mjs --phase 4 accepts for each P4-E row, by the place its row names (phase 4 specification, section 19), so an exclude, a skipped suite or a deleted file cannot pass unnoticed. P4-E14 reads loam-exit-check.p3.minimums.json, and through it phase 2's; E11 is withdrawn (menus are deferred, section 9), and E12's budget and E16's check have no count beyond their titles.

Each is the count step 11's dispatch observed: loam.yml run 45090164323 and ci.yml run 45090167153, on main at b1f081385 (2026-11-23). When exit tests are added or removed on purpose, run the check on a run that has them with --phase 4 --print-minimums, and copy the counts it prints here in the same pull request, saying why each changed.
